headline: Bid awards for fire alarm systems, gym wall padding, and a boiler replacement, plus updates on the new high school and state testing scores.
summary: The meeting includes a closed executive session on the superintendent's annual evaluation and proposed renewal contract, and on a school safety plan. Open session items include bid awards, fundraisers, and a status update on the new South Kingstown High School.

Tuesday, October 27, 2026
South Kingstown School Committee Executive Session and Business Meeting
South Kingstown High School Cafeteria
215 Columbia Street
Wakefield, RI 02879
PARKING IS AVAILABLE IN THE HAZARD BUILDING PARKING LOT
**************************
Members of the public wishing to access this meeting may do so at
https://live.myvrspot.com/st2?cid=OWYyZm
Such virtual access is being provided only as a convenience and shall not be construed as an
official “location” where access to the meeting is guaranteed. The only way to guarantee
complete access to this meeting is to be physically present thereat.
**************************
PUBLIC COMMENT can be done in person at the meeting (South Kingstown High School Cafeteria)
**************************
Posted: 10/23/2026
1. 5:30 PM - Call to Order/Roll Call
A. Call to Order
B. Roll Call
2. Executive Session
A. The School Committee may seek to Recess to Executive Session for Discussion and/or Action regarding those
items of business exempt from open meetings under RIGL 42-46-4 and A: Discussion: Personnel/Job Performance -
Superintendent Annual Evaluation and Proposed Renewal Contract (RIGL 42-46-5(a)(1)) and B: Discussion/Action:
School Safety Plan (RIGL 42-46-5(a)(3)). Individuals have been notified, including their right to have any discussion
held in open session.

Elementary, Broad Rock Middle School, South Kingstown High School)
4. Comments from the Community
A. Comments from the Community (Please Sign Clipboard)
5. Consent Agenda

8. Adjournment
A. Adjourn
The order of business maybe altered or suspended at any meeting by a majority of those present. A vote may be taken on any
item on this agenda. Each regular meeting shall continue until such time as all matters on the agenda have been considered and
acted upon, provided, however, that at 10 pm the chair shall call for actions required before adjournment and a subsequent
motion to adjourn. The school committee may go into executive session under Title 42, Ch. 46, Section 5 of the General Laws of
Rhode Island.

Any changes to this Agenda will be published on the school district’s website, at the two public locations required by R.I. Gen.
Laws § 42-46-6, and transmitted to the Secretary of State’s website at least forty-eight (48) hours in advance of the meeting.
